title: The Rainiest Country on Earth Isn't Where You Think #didyouknow #facts
description:
Colombia gets about 3,240 mm of rain a year on average (World Bank data), ahead of São Tomé and Príncipe, Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands and Panama.
